paraphrase: An explicit serial Bool two-cycle with constant atomic valuation has fixed-language MC at both non-reflexive worlds, possible and necessary language MC, but no full-predicate MC at either world. Every fixed-language formula has identical truth at both labels; the language is negation-closed, but root identity is not expressible and world extensionality fails. No formula is contingent at the root because it has one successor. The extended predicate w=true still witnesses possible truth without actual truth.
